_comment: All three manifests bump in lockstep on a cwmconnect release: the component, the bundled site module, and the bundled finder plugin. The component is the primary surface; the module + finder plugin only ship from this repo and have no independent release cadence. ARS categoryId/updateStreamId are placeholders — populate before first release (run `cwm-ars-list` against the CWM ARS site to discover IDs).
_profile_comment: Component-shaped versionTracking despite the package wrapper — cwmconnect owns its own versions.json + package.json on a single cadence. The substituteTokens.paths override drops 'language/' (cwmconnect has no top-level language/ dir; language files live under admin/language, site/language, modules/site/mod_birthdayanniversary/language, and plugins/finder/cwmconnect/language — all reached via the admin/, site/, modules/, plugins/ scan roots).

build._comment:
Builds com_cwmconnect.zip — the component only (cwmconnect.xml, script.php, admin/, site/, media/com_cwmconnect/). cwm-package runs this as the 'self' include, then bundles it with the seven other sub-zips into pkg_cwmconnect-{version}.zip. outputGlob points at the PACKAGE output (what cwm-release publishes), not the component output.
Sources are listed explicitly rather than 'from: .' because this repo keeps docs/, tests/, libraries/vendor/ and node_modules/ at the top level — an allow-list is safer than a deny-list here.
IMPORTANT: excludes/excludePaths match the path RELATIVE TO EACH source root, not the path inside the zip. So the photo rules are 'photos/*', not 'media/com_cwmconnect/photos/*'. Getting that wrong silently shipped 5183 live member photos (53 MB of PII) into the first build.
The photo rules are per-extension rather than a blanket 'photos' directory exclude so that photos/.htaccess and photos/web.config — both tracked, and the only thing that creates the directory and protects it on a fresh install — still ship. fnmatch '*' crosses '/', so these also cover photos/thumb, photos/web and photos/households.
The '.php' and 'nect.xml' excludePaths are a STOPGAP for a cwm-build-tools bug. PackageBuilder::addDirectory() derives the zip entry name with substr(getRealPath(), strlen($sourceReal) + 1). getRealPath() follows symlinks, so admin/script.php and admin/cwmconnect.xml — the untracked dev symlinks that `composer link` points at the repo root — resolve ABOVE the source root and get sliced into the corrupt entries 'admin/.php' and 'admin/nect.xml'. Those two globs drop them. Remove both once PackageBuilder skips symlink targets that escape the source root.
build._verifyMedia_comment: Checks media/com_cwmconnect/js against the three .es6.js sources rollup builds from. verifyMediaSources catches built output whose source is gone; verifyMediaFreshness catches built output OLDER than its source — edited and never rebuilt, so the package ships the previous build's behaviour under a new version number. ⚠️ ignore lists the two files in that directory that are NOT build output and never will be: jscolor.min.js is vendored third-party and geoupdate.js is hand-written; both are declared in joomla.asset.json and geoupdate is referenced from ten PHP files. (churchdirectory.js was a third, deleted 2026-09-15 as dead MooTools code.) Without the exemption parity reports all three as orphans on a correct tree. Keep this list short — it exempts exactly what it names, and a list that grows until the check is silent is worse than no check. No css pair: media/com_cwmconnect/css has no build/media_source counterpart at all, so every file in it would be an orphan. Needs cwm/build-tools >= 1.35 for ignore; older versions reject or ignore the key. Background: cwm-build-tools#159, #166.

preBuild._comment: Wipes build/dist so a stale zip from a prior build cannot be picked up by outputGlob, then regenerates the two gitignored build outputs the package needs: media/com_cwmconnect/{css,js} via rollup, and libraries/mpdf/vendor via composer (lib_mpdf ships that vendor tree).
preBuild.command: rm -rf build/dist && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && composer install --working-dir=libraries/mpdf --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction

ars.itemDescription: CWM Connect — Church Photo Directory component for Joomla 5/6, with a birthday/anniversary site module and Smart Search adapter for directory entries.

assets._comment: Drives `npm run build:assets` (cwm-build-tools build-assets.js): copies third-party libraries from node_modules into media/com_cwmconnect/vendor so they ship with the package.

dev._comment: Drives cwm-link / cwm-link-check / cwm-clean / cwm-verify against the developer's local Joomla install(s). Component admin/site/media + the bundled module + finder plugin are auto-derived from manifests.extensions[]; the internalLinks entry replaces the manual `ln -s` step previously documented in CLAUDE.md.

package._comment: Assembles pkg_cwmconnect-{version}.zip with the eight inner zips named by build/pkg_cwmconnect.xml. innerLayout is 'root' because that manifest lists the child zips at the package root, with no packages/ prefix. Inner zip filenames must match the <file> entries in that manifest exactly.

config._comment: mpdf.xml declares <files folder="libraries/mpdf">, so vendor/ and language/ must sit under that path inside the zip while the manifest itself lands at the zip root.
